Description
The 50 gram Argor Heraeus gold bar is a high-quality investment product made by one of the world’s leading precious metals refineries. Each Argor Heraeus gold bar contains 1.6075 ounces of 99.99% pure gold, making it a valuable addition to any investment portfolio.
Investors who choose a 50 gram Argor Heraeus gold bars can be confident that they are investing in a product of exceptional quality and value. With a long-standing reputation for excellence, Argor Heraeus Gold Bar is a trusted name in the precious metals industry.
Design of
50 Gram Argor Heraeus Gold Bar (In Assay)
On the obverse of these 50 gram Gold Bar Argor Heraeus features numerous elements which are arranged vertically down the face of the bar. These include the Argor-Heraeus stamp at the top. Below you’ll find the inscription “Switzerland” along with the bar’s weight and the purity indicated. An assayers label with a specific serial number can also be found at the bottom of the 50 gram  Argor Heraeus gold bar 9999 fine.
The reverse side of the Argor Heraeus gold bar 50 gram may either feature the Argor-Heraeus logo in a repeating pattern or may feature a blank design.
Main Highlights of 50 Gram Argor Heraeus Gold Bar (In Assay)
Each Argor Heraeus gold bullion bar contains 50 grams of .9999 pure gold from the Swiss refinery Argor-Heraeus.
Each Argor Heraeus 50 gram gold bar is delivered in a protective sealed assay card.
The 50 gram Argor Heraeus gold bar is eligible for precious metal IRAs.
Features its own Argor-Heraeus logo, Purity, and Weight.
Argor Heraeus Gold Bars has its own unique serial number for added security and theft protection.
